title.narrative: Supporting handicrafts and design value chains in Tunisia

description.narrative: The project supports the development and competitiveness of 17 handicraft value chains in Tunisia. It aims to enhance networking and clustering, introduce innovation and creativity into Tunisian products, improve access to new markets, and facilitate the emergence of entrepreneurial and associative initiatives with high socio-economic potential. The project also focuses on strengthening the role of public institutions within the handicrafts sector and ensuring the sustainability of the initiatives undertaken through the establishment of Creative Hubs.
